purpose: Project-scoped advisory developer guidance for native macOS SwiftUI (issue #149). Advisory only: not a product feature, not a runtime or build dependency, and never vendored into FormaCore or FormaApp.
authority_order: Apple HIG and Apple framework documentation
the ADS revision pinned in ads-pin.txt (.ads gitlink)
Forma project documents (docs/SPEC.md, docs/UI-DESIGN-CONTRACT-PROPOSAL.md once accepted)
third-party advisory skills recorded in this file
non_goals: A skill is never a runtime dependency and is never bundled into the app; no npm, no package resolution and no build step is run by scripts/install_skills.sh.
A skill never overrides Apple HIG, the pinned ADS revision, the macOS 14 deployment minimum or Swift language mode 6.
Rules that assume iOS 27, iPhone-only layouts, Swift 6.4 or a newer Xcode than CI's macOS-15/Xcode 26.3 are rejected on review; use #available only where an actual API requires it.
The secondary skill is not a permanent instruction dump: it is invoked file-by-file for independent review of key SwiftUI PRs only.
The skills' own helper scripts are never executed by the installer; anything that drives xctrace/Instruments runs only on a Mac with explicit scope.

skills.name: swiftui-expert-skill
skills.declared_version_source: plugin.json at the pinned commit (also package.json `pi.skills` -> ./skills/swiftui-expert-skill)
skills.use_scope: Implementation assistance for macOS scenes and windows, toolbar and inspector placement, state and layout, accessibility, and reading xctrace output. Guidance, not authority.
cautions: skills/swiftui-expert-skill/scripts/record_trace.py, analyze_trace.py and the instruments_parser directory drive xctrace on macOS only; never executed here.
references/latest-apis.md and liquid-glass.md may assume OS versions above the Forma baseline; treat them as future work, not as rules for this codebase.
the upstream repository also ships .agents/skills/update-swiftui-apis; that is an upstream meta-skill, not a Forma rule source.

skills.name: swiftui-pro
skills.role: secondary independent reviewer, selected files only
skills.declared_version_source: SKILL.md front-matter `metadata.version` at the pinned commit
skills.use_scope: Independent second opinion on key SwiftUI PRs (App Shell, navigation, review desk), restricted to the five reference files named in issue #149. Never a permanent agent instruction set, never both skills in the same prompt by default.
skills.optional_references_rule: Pull one of these in only when the reviewed rule needs it (resizability → window geometry, performance-plus → traces, accessibility → VoiceOver, localization → copy) and record which file was read in the PR.
cautions: reviewer-only: adopting its advice still requires the Apple/ADS hierarchy in this file and a human reviewer.
resizability.md and design guidance may target platforms newer than macOS 14; the Forma baseline wins.
